scripts.build:agent-first: npm --prefix packages/agent-ui run build && npm --prefix packages/agent-host run build
scripts.build:domain-pages: npm --prefix apps/assets run build:ui && node apps/scanning/build-native-page.mjs
scripts.build:desktop-agent-host: npm run build:app-packages && npm run build:agent-first && node tools/prepare_desktop_agent_host.mjs
